blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — A social enterprise from Negros has brought international acclaim to the country after winning the Main Seoul Design Award at Seoul Design Week 2026 for its eco-friendly footwear line made from agricultural waste, the Philippine Embassy in Korea announced on Monday, Oct. 26. Filipino social enterprise Lakat by Creative Definitions received the prestigious award for its innovative Lakat Sustainable Sneakers, crafted from discarded pineapple leaf waste. The recognition highlights a design approach that unites sustainability, local craftsmanship, and inclusive livelihoods, the embassy said in a social media post.
